# RollEndShop

> Yorkshire's No1 carpet outlet — end of line carpets and roll ends at clearance prices, sold from our Bradford store on Valley Road.

Every roll end is a one-off piece with a fixed size and a red reference number. Browse online, note the reference, then call 01274 057433 to reserve and pay. Collection from the shop or local delivery.
